description: Sets the venue logo from a public https link to a PNG, JPG or WebP file (up to 300 KB), and/or its three colours as #rrggbb: hot (buttons, highlights), fresh (light accent), sun (yellow accent). Colours need the Plus or Pro plan (included in the trial). Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.
